# Jonathan Rebullo (NEO REBULLO) — AI Automation Specialist

> Jonathan Rebullo is an AI Automation Specialist based in Parañaque City, Philippines (UTC+8), working remotely. He builds AI agents, RAG chatbots, CRM integrations and n8n workflow automations that reduce repetitive work for businesses that depend on leads and appointments. Before automation, he spent six years in sales (2020–2026).

## Services

- AI voice agents and appointment booking (Vapi, n8n, Google Calendar)
- GoHighLevel CRM setup and lead automation (pipelines, forms, roles, lead assignment)
- n8n automation and AI agents (API and webhook integrations, AI assistants that answer from a company's documents)

## Projects

- [AI Voice Appointment Setter](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): Vapi voice assistant with n8n workflows that check Google Calendar availability and book, reschedule or cancel appointments during the call; bookings logged to Airtable. Recorded test runs on the site.
- [Messenger AI Lead Agent → GoHighLevel](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): Facebook Messenger AI agent (n8n + Google Gemini) that answers property questions, collects and confirms a buyer's details, then saves the contact, opportunity, note and a follow-up task to GoHighLevel. Tested end to end on a demo Facebook Page.
- [GoHighLevel CRM Pipeline Management](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): real estate sales pipeline where every deal has an owner and each agent sees only their own leads.
- [GoHighLevel CRM Lead Automation](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): property inquiries from a GoHighLevel form become contacts and pipeline opportunities automatically.
- [RAG Knowledge Assistant](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): chat assistant that answers from a team's own documents, synced from Google Drive, with a Supabase vector store.
- [Facebook Messenger AI Chatbot](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): Messenger assistant that answers customer questions from the business's own information.
- [HR Job Posting & Evaluation Assistant](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): hiring workflow that takes in applications, evaluates CVs with AI and schedules interviews.
- [Zapier & Make.com Automations](https://rebullojonathan.github.io/#work): lead engagement, lead enrichment, content repurposing and app integrations.

## Tools

n8n, GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make.com, Vapi, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Supabase, Airtable, Google Workspace, APIs and webhooks.

## Training

Training certificates (certificates of completion, not vendor certifications): No Code Automation with Zapier, No Code Automation with Make.com, HighLevel CRM and Prompt Engineering from Tara AI Community+; AI Automation with n8n from Technical Virtual Assistants PH.
